note: Rewritten from the species description in Scheffrahn & Roisin (2018), originally in English; the species has no soldiers; only males are recorded for the alate (7 specimens, measurements from 6); in the original the antennal relative-length formula appears as "23=4=56" because superscripts were lost and cannot be read, so only the segment count 13 is recorded; the species name is misjoined in several places in the original as "Anenteotermescherubimi" and "Aneneteotermes", an artefact of PDF extraction; figure numbers, type material, key insertions and discussion are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The smallest soldierless termite known from Africa, with a mean worker head width of 0.493 mm; the next smallest are Acidnotermes praus (head width 0.52 mm) and An. nanus (0.56 mm). The enteric valve is highly distinctive: it bears two broad, symmetrical pectinate paddle-like projections, whereas other Anenteotermes have two narrow paddles and the other soldierless genera have three-radiate, six-radiate or asymmetrical enteric valve armatures. Preserved workers show the morphology before autothysis and the consequences of abdominal rupture.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Monotypic, very small, about 2 mm. Head capsule pale yellow, bearing about 100 setae of varying length. Postclypeus moderately arched, frontal gland pore indiscernible. In profile the anterior margin of the abdomen rises vertically above the metanotum, its apex delimited by a dehiscence line. Antenna 13-segmented. Apical tooth of the left mandible separate from marginal tooth 1 and long, projecting distinctly beyond the line joining marginal tooth 3 and the molar prominence; in dorsal view a further accessory (4th) marginal tooth is visible above the molar prominence. Apical tooth of the right mandible much longer than marginal tooth 1, marginal tooth 3 nearly symmetrical. Fore tibia moderately inflated, width/length 0.32. Midgut tongue long and tubular, forming a long mixed segment. First hindgut segment (P1) connected to the third (P3) through a broad conical enteric valve seat shaped like a sunflower receptacle. Enteric valve cuticle made up of 6 unequal pads: the two largest have soft bases, are covered with fringed scales and 5—6 narrow spines, and bear sclerotized extensions that expand into wing-like paddles; the margin is finely pectinate, each extension bearing 40—70 composite spines, with about a dozen separate spines inside the extension. The remaining pads are soft, scaled and without spines; the intermediate pad between the two largest is about half their size; the two small pads flanking the largest pair are about half the size of the intermediate pad; the pad opposite the intermediate one is about as long as it but narrower. The soft pads are anchored in the seat, the seat cavity is filled with bacterial mucus, and the extensions reach the middle of the P3 lumen. Measurements (4 nests, 18 workers, mm; mean±SD): head length including postclypeus 0.482±0.019, head width 0.493±0.015, postclypeus length 0.120±0.007, pronotum width 0.299±0.016, hind tibia length 0.366±0.009, fore tibia length 0.333±0.015, fore tibia width 0.106±0.010, fore tibia width/length 0.320±0.033, total length 2.17±0.23.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: (Male) very small, about 7 mm. Vertex and frons dark brown, postclypeus slightly paler; genae and labrum pale brown. Frontal gland pore oval, translucent. Compound eyes dark brown. Pronotum paler than the head capsule. Meso- and metanotum slightly paler than the pronotum, their posterior margins tinged yellow. Abdominal tergites and sternites pale brown, the middle of the sternites paler. Wing membrane pale brown, veins darker. Legs pale brown. Posterior part of the head capsule rounded. Compound eyes medium-sized, protruding. Ocelli oval, close to the compound eyes. Antenna 15-segmented. Pronotum slightly wider than long, semi-octagonal, the anterior corners bent downwards, the posterior margin nearly straight. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum narrow and wavy. Wings long, projecting beyond the end of the abdomen by about half their length. Measurements (1 nest, 6 male alates, mm; mean±SD): head length to apex of labrum 0.685±0.023, head length to anterior margin of postclypeus 0.513±0.008, head width (maximum at compound eyes) 0.591±0.013, interocular distance 0.447±0.011, maximum diameter of compound eye 0.183±0.005, distance from compound eye to head base 0.031±0.005, maximum diameter of ocellus 0.075±0.005, distance from ocellus to compound eye 0.017±0.003, maximum pronotum length 0.407±0.007, maximum pronotum width 0.515±0.018, forewing length (from wing suture) 5.89±0.08, maximum forewing width 1.51±0.06, hind tibia length 0.523±0.009, total length with wings 7.09±0.09, total length without wings 3.92±0.16.
